info.title: ReproCrowd API
info.summary: Build computational-reproducibility packages for scholarly papers.
info.description:
The HTTP API. Run with ``rc serve``; interactive docs at /docs (Swagger UI) and /redoc.

Conventions: versioned under /v1; JSON bodies; errors are RFC 9457 problem details; POST creates (201 +
Location), PUT replaces explicitly, PATCH is a JSON merge patch, DELETE returns 204; every package-scoped
response carries the package's ETag, and unsafe requests may send If-Match (412 on mismatch).

put.summary: Create or replace the master script
put.description: Resolves the plan (load steps for used data inputs → enabled actions → results step), writes `analysis_plan.json`, `results_schema.json`, the template's files and README.md. Returns 201 the first time, 200 when replacing. Files edited since they were generated (e.g. by the agent) are protected: `on_modified` = refuse (409), keep (regenerate the rest) or overwrite. Claims mode (the package has claims): the plan covers the ticked claims; the master file is a generated runner, the shared preparation file is written if missing, and each ticked claim gets its own file (`claims/C1.py`), rewritten only when the claim changed; `on_modified` does not apply.

422.description: `nothing_to_script`: At least one enabled target and one enabled action are needed

400.description: `unknown_template`: No such master-script template; `template_not_claims_ready`: The template has no claims mode; pick one with a [claims] table (python, r)

409.description: `script_modified`: Generated files were changed since; pass force to overwrite

post.description: `type: codegen` runs the configured coding agent in the package folder to implement the master script's `TODO(LLM):` markers. `type: run` runs the master script with the template's command (output and errors as `log` events), then checks `outputs/results.json`. The package is committed to git before and after. Returns 202 at once; follow the job at its `Location`, its progress at `…/events`.

get.summary: Compare reproduced results with the targets
get.description: Reads `outputs/results.json` and compares it with the targets of `results_schema.json` (the ones the code was written against). Numbers are rounded to the reported decimals (`rounding=reported`) or to a fixed number; a deviation up to `threshold` % counts as within tolerance; tables are compared cell by cell.

get.summary: State and result of every claim
get.description: `state` is `not_testable`; `running` (a claim's codegen job, or any run job for the ticked claims); the verdict (`reproduced`, `partly`, `not_reproduced`) when the claim ran and has not changed since; otherwise `ready` (ticked) or `review`. A changed claim is `stale` and keeps its last `result`. A claim's verdict pools all the evidence of the claim and its sub-claims; `by_sub_claim` lists theirs.

get.description: Every claim in the trace format: the paper's DOI and title, the claim's id, text, mode, links, sub-claims and evidence (reported value, comparator, decimals, readable source; no tolerance: values are compared with the package-wide rule), methods, the coding agent's `# ASSUMPTION:` comments in the claim's file and the prepare file, its state and (last) result. `skipped`: the sentences the enabled claims run passed over. The report and the archive write the same object to `claims_trace.json`. Empty without claims.

put.summary: Get the original figure of a figure target
put.description: Writes `targets/figures/<target>.png`, best first: the image as published, when a JATS full text names it and Europe PMC has it; the figure's area, from a full text that locates it (matched by caption when the target refers to an extraction without coordinates, such as JATS or a reconciled one); the whole page with the figure's caption. `method` says which, and `note` why the published image wasn't available if that failed. Naming a `pdf` skips the published image. The report shows the original next to the reproduced figure. 201 the first time, 200 when replacing.
